effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of equipment Total Armour, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.
body.name: Teragard's Aegis

assumptions: Teragard's Aegis uses equipment Total Armour only (the Loadout Hero armour sum). Defence level, Fortitude, prayer or curse block levels, and blockArmourRating do not change the share.
The shield and defender shares are the card's flat 25/50/75%, so the percentage resolves before the single rounding.
Only a genuinely wielded off-hand qualifies; a stored shield or defender under a two-handed weapon does not, and a shield effect granted by an ability is not a wielded shield.
The equipment-armour share is added to base ability damage before the ability's own damage band.

reason: Live confirmation: Aegis is equipment armour only; align support copy with totalArmour math. (No remove-record: nested support path is absent on clean rebuild.)
